selection: Full finite permission sweep retained, including every repetition, baseline, negative and population. Bulky frozen source, executable and complete disassembly are recoverable through artifact.json; no minimum-only selection.

checks.owner: all-width/all-kind bucket-read permissions, promotion, bags, deletion, reuse, and refusal passed
checks.recipe: recipe exact and widened access, guard thresholds, poisoned neighbors, independent bytes, damage and refusal passed

limitations: Single-writer exclusive-owner experiment. No shared-reader visibility, MVCC publication, concurrent-writer scaling, DRAM or Loom prefetch claim.

All eight candidate arms use identical exact arbitrary-fit physical layouts, logical contents, seeds, bucket counts and 128-byte units. Only read permission and composed versus Direct bucket-field operations differ; stores retain exact bounds and damage.

Whole-unit read permission requires the entire initialized unit to remain stable under one ownership/protection domain. Active masks exclude neighboring slots/fields. The extra bytes must not belong to an independently mutable or unreadable region.
K8..64, set/map/multimap, A6/A10 except K8 A6 only, common 16-lane fingerprint windows and eight-byte map/multimap payloads. No platform-optimal bucket size or arbitrary payload sweep.

Cardinality is derived from the explicit legacy-capacity control. Exact recipes may have different own occupancy across widths/kinds; this cohort does not compare every format at its own capacity. K8 bypasses a practical compact-list policy.

One fresh process per case/arm in shuffled order, nine repetitions each with a fresh Pool. Each timed read receives a complete matching untimed warmup. Process placement, temporal drift and Abseil seed differences remain uncontrolled; within-process repetitions are not independent machine trials.

Elapsed time uses std::chrono::steady_clock in nanoseconds. Independent hit/miss results are checked per key; the entire serial graph is proved. Set serial work includes a caller dependency, maps derive it from values, and multimap consumption XORs every value.

Direct replaces bucket-field primitive operations only. Hashing, routing, headers, chain lookup and ownership remain common. Full timed-loop codegen is audited separately; the Direct arm is not an independent entire table.
Suffix loads also participate in swap-delete and mutation search, so permission can legitimately affect update/erase timing even though stored bytes are unchanged.

Abseil ordinary/exact-key owners reserve known cardinality, charged to construct. Multimap uses InlinedVector<word,1>, whose actual inline capacity is two on these ABIs; the candidate inlines one. On this update trace 4778/7168 K40 A10 keys allocate candidate bags while the other 2390 grow baseline bags.
Lifecycle sums separately timed construct, build, update, erase and release. Queries, inventories, checks and Pool setup/drain are excluded. It is not uninterrupted lifetime throughput.

Requested bytes, owned capacity and owner metadata are separate; logical bytes means requested+metadata. Baseline backing is unknown (CSV zero sentinel), not measured as zero. RSS, transient peaks and cache residence are not established.

Construct/build/read inventory is measured after build; update after update; erase/release/lifecycle after erase. Build population fields always describe build, even in later phase rows. Equal per-arm logical storage/population was checked.
Host ISA features and microarchitecture change together: Zen5 AVX2 x86-64-v3, Granite native AVX-512, V2 NEON. This does not isolate ISA from microarchitecture.
Byte-read geometry is a descriptive reconstruction of the frozen recipe, checked for capacities against native output, not an independent correctness oracle or evidence of spatial prefetch.

Complete timed CFG and direct loop-helper calls establish fusion and call boundaries, not runtime branch frequency, hardware profiling or cycle causality. Identical normalized helpers can still run at different addresses and in different processes. No read policy is selected from aggregate medians or per-case minima.
